clips.title: The story
paras: Gnoll calls carry across the hills around Lakeshire, where Verner Osgood offers a bounty on Yowler. Stormwind's forces are stretched thin by the Blackrock orcs, leaving the town to rely on visitors against the gnolls.

Gnoll cries still echo through the Redridge hills after lesser gnolls are driven from the paths around Lakeshire. Verner Osgood, the town's farrier, knows the pack will keep raiding while its leader lives. Yowler is a huge, cunning gnoll whose calls direct the pack across the hills. Verner asks for Yowler's paw as proof that the leader has been killed and the calls silenced.

Stormwind's eastern border towns face danger with little help from the kingdom's army. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and disputes over the regency have paralyzed high command. Royal soldiers are focused on the Blackrock orc clans in the north, leaving Lakeshire without defenders against gnolls. Townsfolk such as Verner Osgood arrange their own bounties to keep their homes from being overrun.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, the gnolls are still out there. I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire. And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler, their leader.
Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering! Bring me his paw as proof.
And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason. He is no Mongrel...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yowler is a dangerous creature, friend. If you're not ready for him, I understand.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Again, thank you for your help. The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
